leads.economic_rationale: Moreira & Muir (2017, Journal of Finance) show that realized variance is highly persistent while short-horizon expected equity returns do not rise proportionally with variance, so scaling equity index exposure inversely to variance improves Sharpe and cuts crisis drawdowns.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Leverage-constrained and volatility-shocked institutions experience forced selling in high-variance regimes, creating asymmetric downside risk that inverse-variance sizing sidesteps.
leads.entry_rule: On the first trading day of each month, forecast monthly market variance sigma_hat_t^2 using VIX ((VIX/100)^2 / 12) or 21-day trailing realized variance of daily excess returns; set index futures exposure leverage l_t = min(c / sigma_hat_t^2, 3.0) where constant c is calibrated strictly causally by aligning t+1 returns with t variance over trailing 10 years.
leads.exit_rule: Rebalance index futures position size on the first trading day of each month (cutting size when variance spikes).
leads.rule_description: Causal implementation of Moreira & Muir (2017) volatility-managed equity index futures (US500 /MES): forecasts monthly variance from VIX or 21-day realized variance and sets monthly target leverage w = c / sigma_hat^2 (capped at 3.0x), scaling down during high-vol stress and up in calm regimes; hard intramonth stop-loss is NOT_DISCLOSED; zero grid, zero martingale.

leads.name: Global Equity Index Internal Bar Strength (IBS) Cross-Sectional Daily Mean Reversion
leads.economic_rationale: Kakushadze & Serur (151 Trading Strategies) and QuantConnect Benchmark Alpha demonstrate strong 1-day mean reversion in equity indices closing near their intraday extremes (IBS near 0 rebounds next day; IBS near 1 mean-reverts).
leads.counterparty_mechanism: End-of-day liquidity imbalances, stop runs, and leveraged ETF rebalancing push index closes toward session highs/lows that revert during the next trading cycle.
leads.entry_rule: At each daily close across global equity indices (Lean benchmark tracks SPY, QQQ, EWG/GER40, EWU/UK100, EWJ/JP225 and global country indices), compute Internal Bar Strength IBS = (Close - Low) / (High - Low) whenever Open * (High - Low) != 0; rank cross-sectionally, go LONG the lowest-IBS (most oversold near daily low) indices and SHORT the highest-IBS (most overbought near daily high) indices equally weighted for a 1-day lookback prediction horizon.
leads.exit_rule: 1-day holding horizon rebalance at next daily close based on refreshed IBS cross-sectional ranks.
leads.rule_description: Official Apache-2.0 QuantConnect/Lean cross-sectional Internal Bar Strength mean reversion across global equity indices (US500, US100, GER40, UK100, JP225 equivalents): computes IBS = (Close - Low) / (High - Low) on D1 bars, longs lowest-IBS oversold indices and shorts highest-IBS overbought indices for a 1-day horizon (NullRiskManagementModel in benchmark, so hard stop-loss is NOT_DISCLOSED); zero grid, zero martingale.
